description: Find Contact Improvisation events worldwide: festivals, workshops, intensives, retreats, long jams, residencies, jams and classes. Upcoming by default; a past 'from' date also searches ended events. Use for questions like 'CI festivals in Germany this summer', 'workshops with <teacher>' or 'when was X last year'. Filter by country, city, dates, type, practice or free text. Returns up to 20 events sorted by start date, each with id and citreasurehunt.com URL, plus the total match count. Call get_event for prices, teachers and the full description.

country.description: Country as ISO code ("PT") or English name ("Portugal").

features.description: Only events offering all of these, e.g. ["residential", "meals"] or ["sliding_scale"].

from.description: Window start, YYYY-MM-DD. Default today. Includes events still running on or after this date; a past date also returns ended events.

practice.description: Practice tag, e.g. "contact_improvisation" (default), "conscious_dance", "axis_syllabus", or "any" for all practices.

query.description: Free text matched against title, description and place, e.g. a teacher's name or 'silent'.

to.description: Window end: the latest start date, YYYY-MM-DD.

name: search_events
title: Search events
